metadata.note: Four multi-part, source-specific research questions. The grader checks exact facts; source support is audited separately. The BEAM case asks for the beam_lib module, matching the release note's scope. See bench/deep-live-sources.md.

tasks.prompt: Prepare a brief for an Elixir v1.20.4 and Erlang/OTP 29.1 upgrade. The Elixir release fixed a task-wait hang involving the :limit option; name the exact function. OTP changed the filename representation in a library's error tuples; name the library module and give the old and new types. Use the two official release notes, and cite sources if you can access them.

A team is moving a PostgreSQL 17 cluster with a custom logical-decoding slot to PostgreSQL 18.6. According to the 18.6 release notes, name the two output plugins permitted by default, explain exactly when pg_upgrade --check fails for this migration, and explain why 18.5 is absent. Cite the release notes if you can access them.

For a Kubernetes v1.36 control-plane upgrade, compare Mixed Version Proxy with Service.spec.externalIPs. Give the proxy's feature gate, maturity and default setting. For externalIPs, distinguish what users see in v1.36 from the earliest planned kube-proxy opt-out and final removal versions. Use the official Kubernetes feature and deprecation posts; cite them if available.

As of 2026-09-28, advise a package maintainer about Python 3.15.0rc2. Give its release date and the final-release date scheduled in PEP 790, state the ABI promise for RC-built wheels, and say whether rc2 is recommended for production. Use the official release page and PEP; cite them if available.
